contract: With no binding, describe, alter, and other operations are denied.
A prefixed User:* allow permits a matching read and does not permit a different operation.
A literal deny beats that allow. A superuser is allowed before ACL evaluation, including cluster and transactional-id operations.
Reopen restores the deny and the superuser allow.
limits: This is not the CreateAcls, DeleteAcls, or DescribeAcls RPC.
The listener, produce, and fetch paths do not consult this authorizer yet.
The journal format is the local PLACL001 record.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
